title: Will Watch Dis by Yung Miami have above 12000000 streams during the October 23, 2026 - October 29, 2026 tracking week? Above 12M
rules: If Watch Dis by Yung Miami has above 12M streams during the October 23, 2026 - October 29, 2026, tracking week, then the market resolves to Yes.
rules_secondary:
IMPORTANT INFORMATION: This event pertains to the U.S. and will resolve based on the value reported by Luminate’s API as of 10:00 AM ET on the Sunday immediately following the October 23, 2026 - October 29, 2026 tracking week.

Luminate Data, LLC is a neutral provider of market metrics which does not endorse, verify or participate in any way in the outcomes of any prediction market.

blind.reasoning: Watch Dis is Yung Miami's debut solo album and comes out Oct 23, the first day of the tracking week. It includes her Hot 100 top-20 hit 'Spend Dat' and two remixes, plus features from Travis Scott, Lil Baby, Quavo and Summer Walker. 'Spend Dat' alone probably still gets something like 7-10M U.S. streams a week, and about nine new tracks at roughly 1-2M each would put the album well above 12M. The main risks are that the single has faded more than I think, the new tracks get little attention, the count turns out to be audio-only, or the album is delayed.
blind.falsifier: The album is delayed past Oct 29, or Luminate shows 'Spend Dat' below ~5M weekly streams and the new tracks averaging under ~0.7M each, leaving the album under 12M.

final.reasoning: I cut my estimate from 0.74 to 0.5 because the original 'Spend Dat' may not be on the album, and the low market price is some evidence of weaker demand. Even so, a debut album with a recent top-20 hit, its remixes and big guest artists has a fair chance of 12M+ in its first full week, which is above the 0.34 ask.
